name: Webhook Reprocessor — Failed-Event DLQ State Machine

parameters.query:
-- Pull failed webhook deliveries from the audit_logs table that are
-- (a) past their next-attempt-at watermark and
-- (b) below the retry-budget terminal threshold (8 attempts).
--
-- Schema reference (see prisma/schema.prisma):
--   audit_logs.action LIKE 'WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED_%'
--   audit_logs.metadata JSONB carries:
--     endpoint           (POST target URL — relative to FLEXPAY_API_BASE)
--     payload            (the JSON body to replay)
--     idempotencyKey     (the original delivery key — preserved across retries)
--     attemptCount       (int — 0 on first failure, monotonically increasing)
--     nextAttemptAt      (ISO timestamp — exponential backoff)
--     firstFailedAt      (ISO timestamp — DLQ-clock anchor)
--     status             (PENDING_RETRY | DLQ_TERMINAL | RESOLVED)
--
-- The reprocessor selects only PENDING_RETRY rows whose nextAttemptAt
-- has elapsed and whose attemptCount is < the terminal ceiling. The
-- LIMIT caps per-cycle work to keep the cron tick bounded.
SELECT
  id,
  metadata ->> 'endpoint'                                  AS endpoint,
  (metadata ->> 'attemptCount')::int                       AS attempt_count,
  (metadata ->> 'nextAttemptAt')::timestamptz              AS next_attempt_at,
  (metadata ->> 'firstFailedAt')::timestamptz              AS first_failed_at,
  metadata ->> 'idempotencyKey'                            AS idempotency_key,
  metadata -> 'payload'                                    AS payload,
  action
FROM audit_logs
WHERE action LIKE 'WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED_%'
  AND COALESCE(metadata ->> 'status', 'PENDING_RETRY') = 'PENDING_RETRY'
  AND (metadata ->> 'attemptCount')::int < 8
  AND (metadata ->> 'nextAttemptAt')::timestamptz <= NOW()
ORDER BY (metadata ->> 'nextAttemptAt')::timestamptz ASC
LIMIT 50;

-- Persist the state-machine verdict for the failed-event row.
-- We update metadata JSONB in-place; the audit_log row itself is
-- append-only, but the metadata.status flag is the reprocessor's
-- single source of truth for whether to re-emit this event next tick.
UPDATE audit_logs
SET metadata = jsonb_set(
  jsonb_set(
    jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(
        COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
        '{status}',         to_jsonb($2::text), true),
      '{attemptCount}',     to_jsonb($3::int),  true),
    '{nextAttemptAt}',      COALESCE(to_jsonb($4::text), 'null'::jsonb), true),
  '{dlqReason}',            COALESCE(to_jsonb($5::text), 'null'::jsonb), true)
WHERE id = $1::text;

-- 2xx replay — mark the audit row RESOLVED and log a follow-up
-- audit entry so the resolution is traceable.
UPDATE audit_logs
SET metadata = jsonb_set(
  COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
  '{status}', '"RESOLVED"'::jsonb, true)
WHERE id = $1::text;

INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, "actorType", "actorId", action, "resourceType", "resourceId", metadata, "createdAt")
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  'system',
  'workflow:webhook-reprocessor',
  'WEBHOOK_REPLAY_RESOLVED',
  'AuditLog',
  $1::text,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'endpoint',        $2::text,
    'idempotencyKey',  $3::text,
    'attemptCount',    $4::int,
    'statusCode',      $5::int
  ),
  NOW()
);

parameters.text:
=:rotating_light: *Webhook DLQ — terminal* 
Event id: `{{$json.id}}`
Endpoint: `{{$json.endpoint}}`
Idempotency-Key: `{{$json.idempotency_key}}`
Reason: `{{$json.dlqReason}}`
Final status: `{{$json.statusCode}}` after `{{$json.nextAttemptCount}}` attempt(s)
First failure: `{{$json.first_failed_at}}`
_Action required: triage the failed delivery in the admin dashboard and either RESOLVE manually or REJECT permanently._

parameters.query:
-- Loud-but-immutable DLQ audit. The metadata.status flag is the
-- machine signal; this row is the human-facing trail. The on-call
-- triages from the admin dashboard, which queries this action code.
INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, "actorType", "actorId", action, "resourceType", "resourceId", metadata, "createdAt")
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  'system',
  'workflow:webhook-reprocessor',
  'WEBHOOK_DLQ_TERMINAL',
  'AuditLog',
  $1::text,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'endpoint',         $2::text,
    'idempotencyKey',   $3::text,
    'attemptCount',     $4::int,
    'lastStatusCode',   $5::int,
    'dlqReason',        $6::text,
    'firstFailedAt',    $7::text,
    'requiresHumanIntervention', true
  ),
  NOW()
);

-- End-of-tick rollup: how many events did we move through the
-- state machine? A single SUMMARY audit row per cron tick keeps the
-- post-mortem trail searchable without flooding the table.
--
-- The numbers come from a window scoped to the past 15 minutes
-- (3x the tick interval so consecutive ticks overlap and a single
-- dropped tick doesn't blind the dashboard).
INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, "actorType", "actorId", action, "resourceType", "resourceId", metadata, "createdAt")
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  'system',
  'workflow:webhook-reprocessor',
  'WEBHOOK_REPROCESSOR_TICK_SUMMARY',
  'System',
  'webhook-reprocessor',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'pendingRetry', (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs
      WHERE action LIKE 'WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED_%'
        AND COALESCE(metadata ->> 'status','PENDING_RETRY') = 'PENDING_RETRY'
        AND "createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
    ),
    'resolvedSinceLastTick', (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs
      WHERE action = 'WEBHOOK_REPLAY_RESOLVED'
        AND "createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
    ),
    'dlqTerminalSinceLastTick', (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs
      WHERE action = 'WEBHOOK_DLQ_TERMINAL'
        AND "createdAt" >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
    )
  ),
  NOW()
);
